propertyEvents.result: Weigh management’s plans: probable of being carried out, and enough to alleviate the doubt?
propertyEvents.source: 04 Debt/Cinderbrook Bank commitment letter October 16 2026.pdf
propertyEvents.locator: PDF page 1; Cinderbrook Bank’s commitment to renew the line of credit, its covenant relief, conditions and acceptance

propertyEvents.result: Before management’s plans, the conditions raise substantial doubt: the line, $3,500,000.00, matures March 31, 2027, inside the year to October 22, 2027, and without its renewal cash runs out. The plans: Cinderbrook Bank’s commitment of October 16, 2026, binding once accepted and accepted October 20, 2026, renews the line to March 31, 2029, past the look-forward. Its conditions are in management’s hands: audited statements by October 28, 2026, the September certificate by November 14, 2026, no dividends until closing (resolved October 20), and tangible net worth at least $6,000,000.00, which the adjusted $6,217,264.00 meets. With the renewal even the stressed forecast stays above the minimum. The evidence supports doubt that is alleviated by management’s plans; the CPA decides.

propertyEvents.result: Compare the draft going concern note with what the evidence supports
propertyEvents.source: 01 Client Accounting/Draft FY2026 notes and going concern evaluation.docx
propertyEvents.locator: Word paragraphs; the draft going concern and subsequent events notes and management’s going concern evaluation

propertyEvents.result: The draft note says management found no conditions or events that raise substantial doubt. That is not what happened: they raised it, and the plans alleviate it. ASC 205-40 then requires the note to describe the conditions, management’s evaluation of their significance and the plans that alleviate the doubt (GC-01). Proposed wording for the CPA: “conditions and events … raised substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern within one year after the date the financial statements are available to be issued … management’s plans … alleviate the substantial doubt.” Not “substantial doubt exists”, which belongs only where the plans do not alleviate it and which would put a going concern section in the report. With the doubt alleviated, AU-C 570 calls for no going concern section; the CPA may add an emphasis-of-matter paragraph.
propertyEvents.source: 01 Client Accounting/Draft FY2026 notes and going concern evaluation.docx
propertyEvents.locator: Word paragraphs; the draft going concern and subsequent events notes and management’s going concern evaluation

propertyEvents.result: Substantial doubt raised by the March 31, 2027 maturity · alleviated by the bank’s commitment · the draft note’s wording must change (GC-01)

The disclosures are the larger matter: the draft notes leave out most of what arose after June 30 and say the wrong thing about going concern. June 30 covenants hold after the adjustments; September 30 holds only under the bank’s relief. The CPA decides every item and brings the review forward to the report date. The machine stops here.

log.text: Weigh management’s plans: probable of being carried out, and enough to alleviate the doubt?
log.detail: 04 Debt/Cinderbrook Bank commitment letter October 16 2026.pdf PDF page 1; Cinderbrook Bank’s commitment to renew the line of credit, its covenant relief, conditions and acceptance

log.text: Before management’s plans, the conditions raise substantial doubt: the line, $3,500,000.00, matures March 31, 2027, inside the year to October 22, 2027, and without its renewal cash runs out. The plans: Cinderbrook Bank’s commitment of October 16, 2026, binding once accepted and accepted October 20, 2026, renews the line to March 31, 2029, past the look-forward. Its conditions are in management’s hands: audited statements by October 28, 2026, the September certificate by November 14, 2026, no dividends until closing (resolved October 20), and tangible net worth at least $6,000,000.00, which the adjusted $6,217,264.00 meets. With the renewal even the stressed forecast stays above the minimum. The evidence supports doubt that is alleviated by management’s plans; the CPA decides.

log.text: Compare the draft going concern note with what the evidence supports
log.detail: 01 Client Accounting/Draft FY2026 notes and going concern evaluation.docx Word paragraphs; the draft going concern and subsequent events notes and management’s going concern evaluation

log.text: The draft note says management found no conditions or events that raise substantial doubt. That is not what happened: they raised it, and the plans alleviate it. ASC 205-40 then requires the note to describe the conditions, management’s evaluation of their significance and the plans that alleviate the doubt (GC-01). Proposed wording for the CPA: “conditions and events … raised substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern within one year after the date the financial statements are available to be issued … management’s plans … alleviate the substantial doubt.” Not “substantial doubt exists”, which belongs only where the plans do not alleviate it and which would put a going concern section in the report. With the doubt alleviated, AU-C 570 calls for no going concern section; the CPA may add an emphasis-of-matter paragraph.
